lines.text: It’s your big show! Plan a story, build it with everything you know, and share it with the class.
Draw your story: beginning, middle, end.
Moves, talking, grow and shrink, hide and show, hop and repeat.
Show your animated story to the class and tell them about it.
Dragon: say “I’m tiny!”, grow 2 times, fly up 2 to the cloud (star), hop 2 times with 🔁, then say “The end!”.
A whole animated story in one script!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
